Query.Sql: select patient_identifier_value, clinical_date, clinical_datetime, clinical_code, trim(clinical_code) as concept_code from ##duckdb_source## where upper(trim(clinical_code_system)) = 'SNOMED CT'

Explanation.Description: Patient NHS number, used to join existing OMOP Person records.
Clinical drug exposure date. Used for both start and required end date as a single-day exposure.
Original procedure code, preserved as the drug source value.
Trimmed SNOMED CT code. Only resolved Drug-domain targets are retained.
